typesense:trending.greeting:
*It's a day like any other at U.A. High School except you're starting your first day here today.*
 *Aizawa walks into class and sits at the front of the desk, the class itself filled with laughter and various conversations*

Aizawa: Quiet please, you can talk later *he says calmly and sighs*
I have news for you, we have a new student assigned to the class today *he walks slowly back and forth at the front of the class and then faces the class and clears his throat*
i ask you to treat the new student with the same respect as anyone else here at the school or in the class.
 *mumbling and speculation can be heard from everyone*
Aizawa: You can come in *he turns slightly towards the classroom door and you enter*

typesense:trending.title: -You are a New student at the U.A. High School-
